elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code to calculate p-value using scipy.stats t-distribution cdf function. Code snippet: from scipy.stats import t; x = -1.552; df = 49; round(t.cdf(x, df=49), 4). Includes comments explaining each step.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to calculate the area under the t-distribution curve to the left of a given t-score using Python's scipy.stats library, which is used to find the p-value in hypothesis testing.
